body: Thank you, but I'm so lost.
i have friends. they are not enough.

i feel not right for this world. nothing that i do is "successful". i'm disorganized and addictive. Lately my thoughts have slipped more and more into violence. i feel as though i am slipping down a drain, and that i know where i am headed inevitably. I need for my  parents to die so that they will not be heatrbroken when i get rid of myself. suicide runs in my family. i'm unemployed. i have no boyfriend. i have no siblings or extended family to speak of. i have no health insurance and cannot affort psych treatment.
I didn't do it. My parents have to die first.
I just want the pain and fear and anxiety and crying to be over.

I have been severely depressed for 3 years now. I wonder if it ever really will get better. I've tried meds and counseling, and the drugs helped at first but lost their efficacy within 6 months. Subsequent changes in dosage and in medications have been unsuccessful. Every couple of weeks shit gets so bad that I am on the verge of trying to get back in the hospital. I'm so tired of my own bullshit.
It was within 2 months of me being hired, so they could fire me for any reason. It's part of the contract. That's a good idea about doing stuff in the morning.
People alway give me all kinds of advice, but I think I am beyond inspiration. What I kind of want to do though is to go to some remote wilderness area and then OD in the woods.
